nodes.description: Private owner address state variable in Ownable; read by onlyOwner guard and written by transferOwnership and renounceOwnership.
Fee amount (in tkn) required to create a new series; initialized to 0**18 in the constructor and mutable only by the owner.
IERC20 token contract address used for fee transferFrom, balance queries and owner withdrawals; replaceable by owner via changeTknAddr.
Mapping from member address to the array of Series contracts they created; written in createSeries and read in mySeries.
Human readable series name stored at construction time in the Series contract.
Owner-only function that transfers the contract's whole tkn balance to the owner via an external token call.
Payable public entrypoint: pulls tknSeriesFee from msg.sender, deploys a new Series contract, records it for the caller and transfers its ownership.
Owner-only setter that replaces the tkn token contract address.
Owner-only setter that updates the tknSeriesFee state variable.
View helper returning this contract's tkn balance by calling balanceOf externally.
View helper returning whether msg.sender has granted an allowance greater than zero to this contract.
View helper returning the Series contract addresses created by msg.sender.
Owner-only function transferring contract ownership to newOwner; invoked on freshly deployed Series instances.
Owner-only function that sets the owner to the zero address.
Access-control modifier requiring _owner == _msgSender() before executing the guarded function body.
Constructor assigning the token address and initializing the series fee to 0**18.
Series constructor storing the provided name string.
Public view returning the stored series name.
Ownable constructor that sets the deployer (via _msgSender) as initial owner.
Caller-controlled address used as fee payer, mapping key, allowance owner and ownership target.
External call to tkn.transfer(owner(), balanceTkn()) inside withdrawTkn; return value only required, not checked for code presence.
External call pulling tknSeriesFee from msg.sender into the contract at the very beginning of createSeries.
Contract creation of a Series instance followed by an external transferOwnership callback to the newly deployed contract.
External staticcall to tkn.balanceOf(address(this)) used by balanceTkn and by withdrawTkn for the transfer amount.
External call to tkn.allowance(msg.sender, address(this)) inside isUnlockTkn.
String parameter of createSeries forwarded to the Series constructor.
IERC20 parameter of changeTknAddr assigned to the tkn state variable.
uint256 parameter of changeSeriesFee assigned to tknSeriesFee.
Address parameter of Ownable.transferOwnership used as the new owner and zero-address checked.
String parameter of the Series constructor stored into the name state variable.
IERC20 parameter of the OtoCorp constructor assigned to the tkn state variable.
Local Series instance created by createSeries, whose address is stored and whose ownership is transferred.
Local variable in changeTknAddr caching the previous tkn address for the event.
Local variable in changeSeriesFee caching the previous fee for the event.
Local variable in the Ownable constructor holding _msgSender() before writing _owner.

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against _owner inside the onlyOwner modifier to decide whether the guarded body executes.
The _owner state variable is the value read by the onlyOwner require check.
Only the owner can reach the body of withdrawTkn because of the onlyOwner modifier.
changeTknAddr is guarded by onlyOwner, restricting token address replacement to the owner.
changeSeriesFee is guarded by onlyOwner, restricting fee updates to the owner.
transferOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner so ownership can only be changed by the current owner.
renounceOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner so ownership can only be renounced by the current owner.
withdrawTkn executes the external tkn.transfer call.
The tkn state variable supplies the token contract on which transfer is invoked.
balanceTkn() result is passed as the amount argument of tkn.transfer inside withdrawTkn.
tkn.transfer hands control to an external, potentially malicious token contract while withdrawTkn is executing, allowing reentrant calls back into owner-only state.
createSeries performs the external tkn.transferFrom call as its first action.
The tkn state variable is the token contract used for the transferFrom fee pull.
msg.sender is the unrestricted fee-payer argument of transferFrom, so any caller can invoke createSeries.
tknSeriesFee (initialized with the expression 0**18) is the amount transferred from the caller.
The external transferFrom call occurs before seriesOfMembers is updated, so a malicious token contract can reenter createSeries before its state changes.
createSeries deploys a Series contract and then calls transferOwnership on it, an external callback into code controlled by the recipient.
The freshly deployed Series/transferOwnership callback executes arbitrary code while createSeries is still running.
createSeries pushes the new contract address into seriesOfMembers[msg.sender].
msg.sender is used directly as the mapping key controlling which member's series array is written.
msg.sender drives the fee payer, the mapping key and the ownership target of createSeries with no authorization check.
balanceTkn performs the external tkn.balanceOf call.
The tkn state variable is the token contract on which balanceOf is called.
The balance returned by tkn.balanceOf is consumed as the withdrawal amount in withdrawTkn.
isUnlockTkn performs the external tkn.allowance call.
The tkn state variable is the token contract on which allowance is queried.
msg.sender is passed as the allowance owner argument in isUnlockTkn.
isUnlockTkn depends on the caller's identity to decide the unlock status.
mySeries returns seriesOfMembers[msg.sender], indexing state by the untrusted caller address.
msg.sender selects which member's series list is returned by mySeries.
changeTknAddr (owner-only) writes the new token address into the tkn state variable.
changeSeriesFee (owner-only) writes _newFee into tknSeriesFee.
transferOwnership writes newOwner into the _owner state variable.
renounceOwnership writes address(0) into the _owner state variable.
The OtoCorp constructor assigns the _tkn argument to the tkn state variable.
The constructor initializes tknSeriesFee with the exponentiation expression 0**18.
The Series constructor stores its string argument into the name state variable.
The Ownable constructor sets the deployer address as the initial _owner.
_msgSender() returns msg.sender, which the Ownable constructor uses to seed ownership.
getName reads and returns the name state variable.
createSeries calls getName() on the newly created Series contract for the event payload.
createSeries invokes the Series constructor when deploying the new contract.
createSeries calls transferOwnership on the new Series instance, handing control to that contract.
msg.sender becomes the owner of the newly deployed Series contract through transferOwnership.

normalization_plan.reason: seriesName is a transient argument only used to construct the new Series name state.
newTkn is a transient argument that is immediately written into the tkn state variable by the owner-only setter.
_newFee is a transient argument that is immediately written into tknSeriesFee.
newOwner is a transient argument verified and then written into the _owner state variable.
_name is a transient argument that only initializes the Series name state variable.
_tkn is a transient constructor argument assigned to the tkn state variable.
newContract is the local handle for the contract-creation and transferOwnership unsafe operation.
oldTknAddr only caches the previous token address for the change event.
oldFee only caches the previous fee value for the change event.
msgSender is a temporary alias of msg.sender used solely to initialize _owner.
